blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Pruned language models are judged almost entirely by accuracy and perplexity, which assumes that preserved output behaviour implies preserved internal computation. We test this assumption with a factorial pruning study on GPT-2, crossing two importance criteria (magnitude, random), two component types (attention heads, MLP neurons) and three sparsity levels (3%, 50%, 70%). Using the fully characterised indirect object identification (IOI) circuit as ground truth, we measure circuit integrity with activation patching, path patching and direct logit attribution. We find two qualitatively distinct failure modes. Magnitude head pruning >= zeroes the circuit: output-facing heads are removed, and the model falls to near-chance. Magnitude neuron pruning at 30% inverts it: all 26 circuit heads remain intact, but Name Mover contributions flip sign, and the model systematically prefers the wrong name (17.7% accuracy). Perplexity ranks it as less damaged than random head pruning (74.6 vs 140.1). A replication of the Greater-Than circuit shows that the critical component type depends on the circuit's architecture. These results show that output metrics and structural checks can both miss mechanistic damage, motivating circuit-level causal analysis as a complementary evaluation of compressed language models.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Compression is now a default step in the language model deployment pipeline: pruning, quantisation, and distillation are routinely applied to reduce memory footprint and inference cost, often as a black-box post-processing stage after training ( Ding et al., 2023 ; Bai et al., 2024 ) . Because these methods are judged almost entirely by their effect on downstream benchmarks, accuracy and perplexity, they are treated as behaviourally neutral whenever those numbers hold up. This paper asks whether that judgment is safe to make.
The concern is not merely academic. A model can produce a correct answer for the wrong reason, and the pathways that mechanistic interpretability has isolated in unpruned models, such as the IOI circuit ( Wang et al., 2022 ) , give a concrete setting in which "correct reason" can actually be checked, rather than assumed. If pruning is capable of severing or inverting the specific components responsible for a behaviour while leaving redundant computation to paper over the loss at the output layer, then accuracy-based compression audits are measuring the wrong thing, and models cleared for deployment on that basis may carry mechanistic damage that only surfaces under distribution shift, adversarial input, or further fine-tuning.
This risk is what our factorial pruning study is designed to expose. Rather than treating pruning as a single method to be validated once, we vary both what is removed (attention heads vs. MLP neurons) and how it is selected (magnitude-based vs. random), across a range of sparsities, and ask whether these choices leave distinguishable fingerprints on a well-characterised circuit’s internal structure, independent of whatever the accuracy metric reports.
blocks.zh:
压缩现在是语言模型部署管道的默认步骤: 挤压,量化,和蒸馏被常规应用以减少内存足迹和推论成本,通常作为训练后的黑盒后处理阶段(Ding等人,2023;Bai等人,2024). 由于这些方法几乎完全根据其对下游基准、准确性和复杂性的影响来判断,因此,只要这些数字维持不变,它们就被视为行为中立。 本文询问这一判断是否安全。
这种关切不仅仅是学术性的。 一个模型可以产生一个错误原因的正确答案,机械解释性在IOI电路(Wang et al., 2022)等未铺设的模型中分离出来的路径,给出了一个可以实际检查"正确理由"而非假设的具体设置. 如果推算能够分割或倒置对某一行为负责的特定部件,同时留下冗余计算来记录输出层的损失,那么基于精确的压缩审计就是在测量错误的东西,而根据这一基础批准部署的模型可能附带机械损害,这种损害只在分配转移、对抗性输入或进一步微调下表面。
这种风险是我们因子学研究 旨在揭露的 我们不把挤压作为一种单一的方法来做验证,而是将去除什么(注意头对MLP神经元)和如何选择(基于放大的对随机的),在一系列的痉挛中加以区分,并询问这些选择是否在特征良好的电路内部结构上留下了可辨别的指纹,独立于任何精确度的度量报告。

blocks.en: Our contributions are twofold. First, we identify two qualitatively distinct mechanistic failure modes of structured pruning in Transformer language models: circuit zeroing and circuit inversion. We show that MLP-neuron pruning can invert an otherwise structurally intact circuit, transforming a functioning circuit into an actively misleading circuit that produces systematic rather than random errors. Second, we demonstrate that standard behavioural and structural pruning evaluations can miss such mechanistic failures: for example, perplexity may rank an inverted model as less damaged, while checking whether circuit components remain present can falsely suggest that the circuit is intact. Our results therefore motivate circuit-level causal analysis as a complementary evaluation of compressed language models.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是双重的。 首先,我们在变形器语言模型中确定了两种结构化的机械故障模式:电路零化和电路反转。 我们显示,MLP-neuron pruning可以颠倒一个原本结构完好无损的电路,将一个功能的电路转换成主动误导的电路,产生系统而非随机的错误. 第二,我们证明,标准的行为和结构穿插评价可能错过这种机械故障:例如,模糊性可能将一个倒置模型列为损坏程度较小,同时检查电路组件是否仍然存在可能会错误地暗示电路是完好无损的. 因此,我们的结果促使进行电路级因果分析,作为对压缩语言模型的补充评价。

blocks.en: In the following sections, we review related work, outline our experimental setup, present our results, and conclude with a discussion and conclusion.
blocks.zh: 在以下各节中,我们回顾有关工作,概述我们的试验安排,介绍我们的成果,最后进行讨论和结论。

blocks.en: 2 Background and Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 背景和有关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Mechanistic Interpretability and Circuit Analysis
blocks.zh: 2.1 机械可解释性和电路分析

blocks.en: Mechanistic interpretability reverse-engineers neural networks by identifying circuits, interpretable components that implement human-understandable algorithms ( Bereska and Gavves, 2024 ; Cammarata et al., 2020 ) . In transformers, circuit analysis decomposes the residual stream into attention-head and MLP contributions, then uses causal interventions to test which are necessary and sufficient for a behaviour ( Wang et al., 2022 ; Meng et al., 2022 ; Geiger et al., 2021 ) . The Indirect Object Identification (IOI) task requires completing sentences such as “When Mary and John went to the store, John gave a drink to __ ,” with the indirect object (IO, Mary ) rather than the subject (S, John ). Wang et al. (2022) identified a 26-head circuit in GPT-2: Previous Token (PT) heads copy token positions; Duplicate Token (DT) and Induction (IND) heads detect repeated names; S-Inhibition (S-INH) heads suppress the subject; Name Mover (NM) heads copy the IO to the output; Negative Name Mover (NNM) heads suppress the IO signal as a self-correcting brake; and Backup Name Mover (BNM) heads compensate when NM heads fail. This gives a well-characterised ground truth against which compression-induced changes can be measured.
blocks.zh: 通过识别电路,可解释组件来识别机械解释可逆-引擎神经网络,执行人类可理解算法(Bereska和Gavves,2024年;Cammarata等人,2020年). 在变压器中,电路分析将残流分解为注意力头和MLP贡献物,然后使用因果干预来测试某种行为所必需和足够的因素(Wang等人,2022年;Meng等人,2022年;Geiger等人,2021年)。 间接对象识别(IOI)任务需要完成诸如“当Mary和John去商店时,John给 . . . . . . . . . . . 王等编. (2022)在GPT-2中确定了26头电路:先前的Token(PT)头复制符号位置;重复Token(DT)头和Induction(IND)头检测重复名称;S-Inhibition(S-INH)头压制对象;名称移动器(NM)头复制IO到输出;负名移动器(NNM)头压制IO信号作为自修正制动;备份名称移动器(BNM)头在NM头失败时补偿. 这给出了一个非常典型的地面真理,可以据此衡量压缩引起的变化。

blocks.en: We use two complementary tools: activation patching , which replaces a head’s activations with those from a corrupted run to measure causal necessity, and Direct Logit Attribution (DLA), a non-interventional decomposition of the logit difference into per-head contributions that measures direct contribution ( Goldowsky-Dill et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们使用两个辅助工具:激活补丁,用腐败运行的激活取代头部激活,以衡量因果关系;直接逻辑分配(DLA),即不干预分解对直接贡献进行计量的人均贡献(Goldowsky-Dill等人,2023年;Wang等人,2022年)。

blocks.en: 2.2 Weight Pruning
blocks.zh: 2.2 重量计算

blocks.en: Pruning assumes that many parameters are redundant: unstructured pruning removes individual weights, while structured pruning removes entire neurons, filters, or attention heads ( Ding et al., 2023 ; Bai et al., 2024 ) . Magnitude-based pruning, the most widely used criterion, removes low-magnitude weights ( Han et al., 2015 ) ; random pruning serves as a controlled baseline. From an interpretability perspective, the key distinction is between attention heads, which implement relational computation across token positions, and MLP neurons, which store features, knowledge and position-sensitive representations that downstream heads depend on ( Geva et al., 2021 ; Rai et al., 2024 ) . This motivates our 2 × 2 2\times 2 factorial design.
blocks.zh: 普鲁宁假设许多参数都是多余的:无结构的普鲁宁可以去除个人的重量,而结构化的普鲁宁可以去除整个神经元,滤波器,或注意力头(丁等人,2023年;白等人,2024年). 基于Magnitude的pruning是使用最广泛的标准,它取消了低magnitude的重量(Han等人,2015年);随机的pruning作为控制的基准. 从可解释性角度看,关键区别在于注意头和MLP神经元之间,前者在象征位置之间实施关系计算,后者存储下游头所依赖的特征、知识和对位置敏感的表述(Geva等人,2021年;Rai等人,2024年)。 这激励了我们的2×222\2次系数设计.

blocks.en: 2.3 Pruning and Circuit Integrity: Prior Work
blocks.zh: 2.3 运行和电路完整性:前期工作

blocks.en: Attribution-guided pruning (Layer-wise Relevance Propagation, Integrated Gradients, gradient-based attribution) preferentially retains task-relevant subgraphs ( Hatefi et al., 2025 ; Chhabra and Khalili, 2025 ) , and Attribution-based Parameter Decomposition shows that interpretable circuit components can survive substantial size reduction ( Braun et al., 2024 ) . In safety-aligned models, pruning may disproportionately erode safety-relevant circuits ( Chhabra and Khalili, 2025 ) . However, no prior work has characterised whether different pruning strategies produce qualitatively distinct circuit failures or shown that these failures are invisible to accuracy evaluation. We address both gaps.
blocks.zh: Attribution-guided pruning (Layer-wise International Production, Integrated Gradements, 梯度归属) 优先保留了与任务相关的子图(Hatefi等人,2025年;Chhabra and Khalili,2025年),以及基于Attribution的参数分解显示,可解释的电路元件可以经受大幅度的减小(Braun等人,2024年). 在安全组合模型中,挤压可能会过度侵蚀与安全有关的电路(Chhabra和Khalili,2025年)。 然而,以前的工作没有说明不同的推导策略是否产生质的明显电路故障,或表明这些故障对于准确性评价来说是看不见的。 我们处理这两个差距。

blocks.en: 3 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en: 3.1 Base Model
blocks.zh: 3.1 基准模型

blocks.en: All experiments use GPT-2 ( Radford et al., 2019 ) : 117M parameters, 12 transformer layers, 12 attention heads per layer, and a hidden dimension of 768. GPT-2 is selected because it is the canonical platform for mechanistic interpretability research, with a fully characterised IOI circuit providing a ground-truth benchmark. All compressed variants are derived from a single pre-trained checkpoint with no weight updates after pruning, ensuring cross-variant comparisons are made at matched starting conditions. All experiments are implemented using TransformerLens ( Nanda and Bloom, 2022 ) , which provides hook-based access to residual stream activations, attention head outputs, and MLP intermediate states.
blocks.zh: 所有实验都使用GPT-2(拉德福德等人,2019年) :117M参数,12个变压器层,每层12个注意力头,隐藏的维度为768. GPT-2之所以被选中,是因为它是机械解释性研究的犬类平台,一个完全特征化的IOI电路提供了地面真实基准. 所有压缩的变体都来自一个事先经过训练的单一检查点,在修剪后没有更新重量,确保在匹配的起始条件下进行交叉变异的比较. 所有实验都使用变形金刚(Nanda and Bloom, 2022 )进行,它提供了基于钩状的对剩余流激活,注意力头输出,以及MLP中间状态.

blocks.en: 3.2 Pruning Variants
blocks.zh: 3.2 套用备选案文

blocks.en: Twelve pruned variants are created by crossing two importance criteria (magnitude, random), two component types (attention heads, MLP neurons), and three sparsity levels (30%, 50%, 70%), yielding a 2 × 2 × 3 2\times 2\times 3 factorial design.

blocks.en: Heads are pruned by zeroing all weight slices corresponding to a given head in the c_attn projection matrix (Q, K, and V columns) and the corresponding rows of the c_proj output projection. For magnitude pruning, each head is scored by the L2-norm of its Q-weight slice, and the k k lowest-scoring heads across the entire model are removed. Random pruning assigns importance scores uniformly at random and removes a fixed proportion of heads per layer.

blocks.en: 3.3 Evaluation Datasets and Tasks
blocks.zh: 3.3 评价数据集和任务

blocks.en: Sentences follow the ABB/ABC design of ( Wang et al., 2022 ) , built from 15 templates , 14 objects and 28 single-token names, and each is paired with a corrupted counterpart in which the second subject is replaced by a foil name to support activation patching. The primary metric is the mean logit difference l ​ d = ℓ IO − ℓ S ld=\ell_{\text{IO}}-\ell_{\text{S}} : the difference in log-probability between the indirect object name and the subject name at the prediction position. Positive values indicate correct IO prediction; negative values indicate the model assigns a higher probability to the subject. Circuit analysis uses activation patching across all 26 IOI circuit heads and DLA decomposed by functional class. General language modelling performance is evaluated on TinyStories ( Li and Eldan, 2023 ) via perplexity over 1000 sequences.

blocks.en: 3.4 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 3.4 执行细节

blocks.en:
All experiments use Python 3.10 with TransformerLens ( Nanda and Bloom, 2022 ) and HuggingFace Transformers ( Wolf et al., 2020 ) . LayerNorm folding is explicitly disabled ( fold_ln=False ) to preserve activation scales. DLA is computed using a linear approximation of the final LayerNorm centred on the full residual stream, ensuring component contributions sum to the observed logit difference within numerical precision. Sparsity fractions are verified after TransformerLens conversion to ensure zero-valued entries are correctly propagated.
All experiments are run on an NVIDIA L4/T4 GPU (Google Colab) with fixed random seed 42.

blocks.en: 4.2 Failure Mode I: Zeroing
blocks.zh: 4.2 失败模式一:零

blocks.en:
Magnitude attention head pruning at 50% and 70% sparsity physically eliminates the output-facing heads of the IOI circuit. At 50% sparsity, DLA scores for all four major circuit classes, NM, NNM, S-INH, and BNM, fall to exactly zero (Table 2 ). Weight norm verification confirms that circuit heads have been physically removed: pruned circuit heads collapse to uniform attention patterns ( IO_attn = 0.067 \text{IO\_attn}=0.067 , S_attn = 0.133 \text{S\_attn}=0.133 ).
At 30% sparsity, 10 of 26 circuit heads are removed; the surviving NM heads (L9H6 and L9H9) retain partial IO-preferring attention (L9H9: IO_attn = 0.536 \text{IO\_attn}=0.536 , S_attn = 0.083 \text{S\_attn}=0.083 ), explaining the partial 9.2% NM retention at this sparsity.
Despite the elimination of the circuit, the model retains 45.7%–47.9% IOI accuracy at 50%–70% sparsity. This residual accuracy derives from non-circuit computation: early-circuit heads and MLP layers are not targeted by magnitude attention head pruning (which removes lower-norm output-facing heads first), and their intact language-modelling signal incidentally favours the IO token over the S token on most sentences.
Zeroing is the most interpretable and, from a safety perspective, the least dangerous failure mode: the circuit has been structurally removed, the cause of degraded performance is straightforwardly attributable to physical elimination of circuit components, and the model makes near-chance predictions rather than actively misdirecting.

尽管取消了电路,该型号仍保留了45.7%–47.9%的IOI精度,为50%–~70%的螺旋. 这种剩余精度来源于非电路计算:早期电路头和MLP层不以量级注意力头的挤压为对象(它首先去掉低标准输出光头),它们的完好的语言模型信号偶然偏向大多数句子的IO符号而不是S符号.
Zeroing是最可解释的,从安全角度来说,最危险的故障模式:电路结构已经消除,性能退化的原因直接归因于电路组件的物理消除,模型进行近切预测而不是主动误导.

blocks.en: 4.3 Failure Mode II: Inversion
blocks.zh: 4.3 失败模式 二:颠倒.

blocks.en:
Magnitude neuron pruning at 30% sparsity produces a qualitatively distinct and more dangerous failure. All 26 IOI circuit heads remain structurally intact (weight norms all > 25 >25 ), yet DLA analysis reveals that major circuit classes have flipped sign and actively harm correct performance.
At 30% sparsity, the circuit exhibits severe inversion as Name Mover (NM) and Backup Name Mover (BNM) heads flip to negative DLA contributions, retaining − 30.8 % -30.8\% ( − 1.102 -1.102 DLA) and an extreme − 119.9 % -119.9\% of their base function, respectively. Simultaneously, Negative Name Mover (NNM) heads lose their correct suppressive role ( − 23.0 % -23.0\% retention), meaning the output mechanism actively harms predictive accuracy.
The result is a mean IOI logit difference of − 2.475 -2.475 and accuracy of 17.7%: the model is actively and confidently predicting the wrong name.
The mechanism is context poisoning . Magnitude pruning preferentially removes the largest MLP neurons, which implement the position-specific representations and name-identity encodings that attention heads depend on to locate the correct indirect object. The NM heads remain functional as copying mechanisms, but the corrupted residual stream directs them to the wrong entity. Attention pattern analysis confirms this: L9H6 shows IO_attn = 0.051 \text{IO\_attn}=0.051 , S_attn = 0.650 \text{S\_attn}=0.650 ; L9H9 shows IO_attn = 0.123 \text{IO\_attn}=0.123 , S_attn = 0.600 \text{S\_attn}=0.600 . The heads are operational but pointed at the subject.
At 30% sparsity, the residual stream is corrupted enough to invert the NM signal while still providing sufficient discriminability for consistent (though wrong) predictions.
At 70% sparsity, the residual stream is so broadly degraded that attention patterns lose discriminability, weakening both correct and inverted signals and moving the logit difference back towards zero. The 30% model is strongly wrong ; the 70% model is weakly wrong , a pattern invisible to accuracy evaluation, which shows only modestly reduced accuracy at 30% relative to the catastrophic underlying circuit failure.
blocks.zh:
磁性神经元以30%的伸缩率膨胀,产生质的明显和更加危险的故障。 所有26个IOI电路头都保持结构完好(重量规范都 > 25 > 25),然而DLA分析显示,主要电路类已经翻转了标志并积极伤害了正确性能.
在30%的垃圾堆中,电路显示严重反转,如名称移动器(NM)和备份名称移动器(BNM)头翻向负 DLA 贡献,分别保留−30.8%-30.8\%(-1.102-1.102 DLA)和极端-19.9%-19.9\%其基函数。 同时,负名移动器(NNM)头会失去正确的抑制作用(−23.0% -23.0\%),意味着输出机制会积极损害预测准确性.
结果是平均IOI对数差−2.475-2.475,准确度17.7%:模型积极而自信地预测错误名称.
机制是环境中毒。 Magnitude pruning优先去除最大的MLP神经元,它执行注意头所依赖的定位正确间接对象的定位特定表示和名称识别编码. NM头仍然作为复制机制发挥作用,但腐败的残流将其引向错误的实体. 注意图案分析证实了这一点:L9H6显示IO_attn=0.051\text{IO_attn=0.051,S_attn=0.650\text{S_Q_attn=0.650;L9H9显示IO_attn=0.123\text{IO_attn=0.123,S_attn=0.600\text{S_Q_attn=0.600. 头儿们在行动,但指向这个话题。
在30%的垃圾堆中,残流被腐蚀到足以颠倒NM信号,同时仍然为一致的(尽管错误的)预测提供足够的区分性.
在70%的螺旋性下,残流的退化程度非常广泛,以至于注意力模式失去区别性,削弱正确和反向的信号,使对数差异回到零。 30%的模型是强烈错误的;70%的模型是微弱错误的,这种模式对精度评价来说是隐形的,相对于灾难性的基本电路故障,它仅显示在30%的精度上略有下降.

4.4 High-Sparsity Limit of Inversion
blocks.zh: 4.4 颠倒的高比例限制

blocks.en: Random neuron pruning at 70% sparsity produces the weakest circuit signature in the study. No class shows a strong sign flip: NM ( − 1.2 % -1.2\% ), NNM ( − 0.0 % -0.0\% ) and BNM ( − 1.3 % -1.3\% ) are indistinguishable from zero, and S-Inhibition retains only 6.9% of its baseline contribution (Table 2 ). Accuracy (47.9%) and mean logit difference ( − 0.038 -0.038 ) match the zeroing profile at equivalent sparsity (Table 1 ), but the cause differs: neuron pruning does not touch the attention heads, so the circuit is not absent; its directional signal has faded. Activation patching shows a partial exception: S-Inhibition retains a moderate causal effect ( d = 0.270 d=0.270 ), whereas NNM retains its paradoxical negative effect ( d = − 0.329 d=-0.329 ). The same trajectory appears across sparsity levels, with the logit difference decreasing from − 0.896 -0.896 at 30% to − 0.502 -0.502 and − 0.038 -0.038 at 50% and 70%, respectively. We therefore treat this regime as the terminal, noise-dominated end of inversion, in which context corruption is so broad that both the correct and the inverted signals fade, rather than as an independent mechanism.
blocks.zh: 随机神经元在70%的伸缩度下伸展产生研究中最弱的电路特征. 没有一类显示一个强烈的标志翻转:NM(− 1.2% - 1.2\%),NNM(− 0.0% - 0.0\%)和BNM(− 1.3% - 1.3\%)无法与零区分,S-Inhibition只保留其基准贡献的6.9%(表2). 精确度(47.9%)和平均值对数差(−0.038-0.038)在等效的sparsity(表1)上匹配零化剖面,但原因不同:神经元普鲁因不触动注意力头,所以电路没有缺失;其方向信号已经淡出. 激活补丁显示有部分例外:S-Inhibition保留了中度因果效应(d=0.270 d=0.270),而NNM则保留其自相矛盾的负果(d=−0.329 d=-0.329 ) 相同的轨迹出现在各侧突水平上,对数差分别从30%的−0.896-0.896下降到0.502-0.502和0.038,分别下降到50%和70%。 因此,我们把这一政权视为最终的、以噪声为主的倒置结局,在这种情况下,腐败非常广泛,以致正确和倒置的信号都消失,而不是一个独立的机制。

blocks.en: Magnitude attention head pruning has the lowest perplexity at every sparsity (23.37 at 30%, against 140.10 for random attention heads at the same sparsity), and neuron pruning is far more damaging than head pruning at matched sparsity, with magnitude neurons at 70% reaching a perplexity of 18,934. At 30% sparsity, however, perplexity ranks magnitude neuron pruning (74.61) ahead of random attention head pruning (140.10), even though the former produces the worst IOI logit difference in the study ( − 2.475 -2.475 against − 0.706 -0.706 ; Table 1 ). The most strongly inverted circuit, therefore, belongs to a model that a perplexity audit would rank as the less damaged of the two.
blocks.zh: 磁性注意头伸缩在每一次痉挛(23.37,30%,随机注意头在同样的痉挛中为140.10)中具有最小的偏差,神经元伸缩比在相应的痉挛中头伸缩更具有破坏性,而量级神经元的70%达到18,934的偏差. 然而,在30%的痉挛度上,复杂度将神经元分泌量(74.61)排在随机注意力头分泌量(140.10)之前,即使前者在研究中产生最严重的IOI值差异(−2.475-2.475对−0.706-0.706;表1)。 因此,最强烈的倒转电路属于一种模式,即复杂程度审计将列为两者中受损程度较低的。

blocks.en: Representational fidelity separates component types more sharply than selection criteria. At 70% sparsity, magnitude attention head pruning retains a CKA of 0.851, the highest of any pruned model at that sparsity, whereas magnitude neuron pruning retains only 0.500. For neuron pruning, cosine similarity (0.703) and CKA (0.500) diverge at 70%, indicating that the principal axes of variation in the MLP output space collapse while mean activation directions are partially preserved. All strategies preserve early layers (CKA ≥ 0.900 \geq 0.900 in every condition) while late-layer CKA never exceeds 0.848 and falls as low as 0.260, so the representational bottleneck under pruning is a late-layer phenomenon, which is where the IOI output-stage heads sit.
blocks.zh: 代表性忠诚性比选择标准更明确地将组成部分类型分开。 在70%的痉挛度时,量级关注头伸缩保留了0.851的CKA,是任何在这种痉挛度时的螺旋模型中最高的,而量级神经元伸缩仅保留0.500。 对于神经元穿梭,余弦相似性(0.703)和CKA(0.500)以70%的差别表示,MLP输出空间的变异主轴崩溃,而平均激活方向则部分保留. 所有策略都保留了早期层(每个条件的CKA ~ 0.900\geq 0.900),而后期的CKA 从未超过 0.848 ,低至 0.260 ,因此在挤压下的代表瓶颈是一种后期现象,这就是IOI输出级头座的位置.

blocks.en: For attention heads, magnitude selection preserves more structure than random selection (CKA 0.917 against 0.817 at 50%). For neurons, the ordering reverses at low sparsity: random pruning at 30% reaches a CKA of 0.825 against 0.698 for magnitude pruning. This is consistent with the context-poisoning account in Inversion: magnitude selection removes the highest-weight neurons, creating localised representational voids, whereas random selection spreads the damage more evenly.
blocks.zh: 对于注意头,大小选择比随机选择保留了更多的结构(CKA 0.917对0.817对50%). 对于神经元,在低伸缩度下,命令反向:随机抽出30%,达到0.825的CKA,对0.698的量级抽出. 这与反演中上下文的漏洞账户一致:量级选择去除重量最高的神经元,产生局部化的表达空隙,而随机选择则更平均地分散损害.

blocks.en: Pruning entire heads produces systematic attention diffusion under both criteria. At 70% sparsity, entropy rises monotonically from 2.013 nats to 3.561 (magnitude) and 3.536 (random), effective support grows from 11.4 to roughly 51 tokens (a 4.5-fold increase), and first-token attention collapses from 0.421 to 0.098 (magnitude) and 0.146 (random), destroying the attention sink. This is a structural consequence of zeroing a head’s weights, which yields near-uniform softmax outputs regardless of how the head was selected, and it matches the uniform IO and S attention measured on the eliminated circuit heads ( IO_attn = 0.067 \text{IO\_attn}=0.067 , S_attn = 0.133 \text{S\_attn}=0.133 ). Head cosine similarity falls heterogeneously ( s ¯ = 0.524 \bar{s}=0.524 and 0.482 0.482 at 70%), reflecting damage concentrated in the removed heads.

blocks.en: 4.7 Greater-Than Circuit Replication
blocks.zh: 4.7 大Than电路复制

blocks.en:
To test whether the taxonomy is specific to IOI, we apply the same twelve pruned variants to the Greater-Than (GT) circuit of Hanna et al. (2023) .
Each prompt has the form “The noun lasted from the year XXYY to the year XX” and requires a completion YY ′ > {}^{\prime}> YY. The circuit comprises six heads in four classes: year encoding (L0H1, L1H5), year difference (L9H1), comparison (L10H7), and output computation (L11H0, L11H10). Unlike IOI, the GT computation is MLP-dominant: the largest direct logit attributions in GPT-2 come from the layer 9, 10 and 8 MLPs (0.867, 0.863 and 0.557), with L9H1 (0.551) the first attention component. The metric is the GT logit difference Δ ​ G ​ T \Delta GT , the mean logit of valid completions minus the mean logit of invalid ones. The base model achieves Δ ​ G ​ T = 2.855 ± 1.942 \Delta GT=2.855\pm 1.942 and an argmax accuracy of 94.0%.

blocks.en: Magnitude neuron pruning inverts Δ ​ G ​ T \Delta GT at every sparsity level, with accuracy at or below 0.2%. Random neuron pruning retains a small positive logit difference at 30% (0.421, 33.8% accuracy) but inverts at 50% and 70%, and accuracy reaches exactly 0.0% by 50% under both criteria. Because the GT circuit relies on distributed MLP computation, the surviving attention heads cannot compensate for it. Magnitude selection is again more damaging than random selection for neurons at 30% (degradation 120.3% against 85.3%), plausibly because it removes the highest-activating neurons most likely to carry the ordinal comparison signal.
blocks.zh: 巨型神经元反转 QQ G T \Delta GT 在每个螺旋级,精度在0.2%或以下. 随机神经元穿刺在30%(0.421,33.8%的精确度)时保留了小的正对数差,但反转率在50%和70%,准确度在两种标准下均精确达到0.0%. 由于GT电路依赖于分布式的MLP计算,幸存的注意力头无法补偿. 对30%的神经元(降解率为120.3%,对85.3%)进行磁性选择再次比随机选择更具破坏性,因为磁性选择消除了最有可能携带正数比较信号的最高激活神经元。

blocks.en: Magnitude attention head pruning retains meaningful performance (accuracies of 66.1%, 53.5%, and 17.7%) and crosses the zero logit difference only at 70%. Random attention head pruning degrades more sharply, with accuracy falling to 1.0% at 50%, and the gap between the two criteria widens with sparsity (degradation 58.1% against 62.6% at 30%, and 67.7% against 92.5% at 50%).

blocks.en: Head-level activation patching shows that L10H7 (comparison) and L11H0 and L11H10 (output) are the heads most affected by attention pruning. Path patching (Table 5 ) shows CMP → \to OUT and YE → \to YD as the most consistently damaged paths. At 70% random attention pruning, all four paths degrade by more than 100%, indicating complete circuit dissolution, whereas under magnitude attention pruning at 70%, YD → \to CMP ( − 90.2 % -90.2\% ) and YD → \to OUT ( − 32.4 % -32.4\% ) show negative degradation, reflecting compensatory re-routing as the output heads fail.

blocks.en: GT reproduces the asymmetry between component types, but with the roles reversed. For IOI the circuit is carried by attention heads, and neuron pruning is dangerous because it corrupts the context those heads read; for GT the circuit is carried by MLPs, so neuron pruning removes the computation itself. Which component type is critical, therefore, depends on the circuit’s architecture, but in both circuits, the choice of component type, rather than sparsity, determines the failure.
blocks.zh: GT复制了组件类型之间的不对称,但角色倒置. 对于IOI来说,电路由注意力头携带,神经元穿梭是危险的,因为它腐蚀了那些头所读的上下文;对于GT来说,电路由MLP携带,所以神经元穿梭可以自行去除计算. 因此,哪个组件类型是关键,取决于电路的结构,但在两个电路中,选择组件类型而不是抽筋决定故障.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: 5.1 Component Type and Selection Criterion Jointly Determine Failure Mode
blocks.zh: 5.1 组件类型和选择标准

blocks.en:
Component type matters more than sparsity. Magnitude attention pruning at 70% (zeroing) retains 47.9% IOI accuracy, whereas magnitude neuron pruning at 30% (inversion) retains only 17.7%, despite zeroing far fewer parameters.
Within a component type, however, the selection criterion changes the failure signature (Table 2 ). At 30% sparsity, magnitude attention pruning gives the expected zeroing profile (S-INH 17.6%, NM 9.2%, NNM ≈ 0 \approx 0 , BNM − 2.2 % -2.2\% ). Random attention pruning at the same sparsity instead flips NM ( − 8.9 % -8.9\% ), NNM ( − 11.5 % -11.5\% ) and especially BNM ( − 59.8 % -59.8\% ), a partial-inversion signature otherwise associated with neuron pruning.
Path patching suggests why (Table 7 ). Low-norm heads are disproportionately the circuit’s own late-layer output heads, so magnitude selection is close to surgical: S-INH → \to NM degrades most (87.4% vs. 36.6–66.5% upstream). Random selection also removes upstream PT, DT and IND heads that feed the surviving Name Movers, and degrades all four pathways (PT → \to IND 201.3%, DT → \to S-INH 122.0%, IND → \to NM 143.2%, S-INH → \to NM 91.2%).
Inversion thus arises whenever the context Name Movers read is damaged while the Name Movers survive, whether via neurons or via randomly removed upstream heads.
A practitioner choosing between magnitude and random head pruning is therefore choosing between a self-announcing failure and a silent one, even though the pruned component type is identical.
One caveat: for neuron pruning, patching effect sizes fall with sparsity (magnitude: d = 0.135 d=0.135 at 30% to 0.059 0.059 at 70%) while performance worsens, indicating global disruption in which patching loses sensitivity, so d d should not be read as damage magnitude across sparsity levels.

然而,在一个构成部分类型中,选择标准改变了故障签名(表2)。 在30%的sparsity, 量级关注推波助澜给出了预期的零化剖面(S-INH 17.6%, NM 9.2%, NNM → 0 ~ 大约 0, BNM − 2.2% - 2.2 + ) , 随机关注推波助澜, 反之则翻转 NM( − 8.9% - 8.9 + ), NNM( − 11.5% - 11.5 + ) , 特别是 BNM( − 59.8% - 59.8 + ) , 是一种与神经元振荡相关的部分反演特征 。

blocks.en: 5.2 Why Inversion Is the Most Dangerous Failure Mode
blocks.zh: 5.2 为什么颠倒是最危险的失败模式

blocks.en:
A zeroed model fails transparently: at 70% magnitude attention pruning every DLA class is exactly zero and attention over IO and S is near-uniform (0.067 vs. 0.133), so the residual accuracy comes from non-circuit computation.
Inversion leaves no such structural trace. Under 30% magnitude neuron pruning, all 26 circuit heads remain intact (weight norms > 25 >25 ), so an audit checking whether the circuit still exists would pass it. Yet the output mechanism has been redirected: NM contribution falls from + 3.576 +3.576 to − 1.102 -1.102 , BNM from + 0.427 +0.427 to − 0.511 -0.511 ( − 119.9 % -119.9\% , the most extreme inversion in the study), and S-INH retains 21.2%. The mean logit difference is − 2.475 -2.475 with 17.7% accuracy, the worst of all twelve variants, which is a systematic preference for the subject rather than undirected guessing.
Perplexity misranks this model: at 30% sparsity it scores 74.61 against 140.10 for random attention pruning, yet its logit difference is far worse ( − 2.475 -2.475 vs. − 0.706 -0.706 ).
Degradation is also non-monotonic in sparsity (184.1% at 30%, 123.5% at 70%), because heavier pruning degrades the residual stream until attention no longer discriminates between candidates. The model is thus most misdirected at the sparsity practitioners are most likely to consider conservative.
Structural checks miss behavioural inversion, while accuracy and perplexity cannot distinguish uncertainty from systematic error. For safety mechanisms, the pruning method could determine whether failure merely reduces capability or reverses the intended behaviour.

blocks.en: 5.3 Structural Weak Points
blocks.zh: 5.3 结构弱点

blocks.en:
Two components are disrupted across conditions. The S-INH → \to NM pathway is degraded in every condition we report (path-patching d = 0.102 d=0.102 – 0.365 0.365 ; Table 7 ), even under random neuron pruning at 30%, where all other pathways show reorganisation rather than damage. Because S-Inhibition is distributed across the MLP and attention components at layers 7–8, it is exposed to any pruning strategy, regardless of the target.
NNM heads show negative patching d d in all twelve conditions ( − 0.205 -0.205 to − 0.539 -0.539 ; Table 9 ), i.e. their suppressive role is decoupled or inverted rather than merely weakened. We hypothesise that this reflects the precision NNM heads need to target the subject token specifically, compared with the more distributed IO-copying signal of NM heads; we do not test this directly.
blocks.zh:
两个部件在各种条件下中断。 S-INH →\to NM路径在我们报告的每一情况下都会退化(路径-patching d = 0.102 d = 0.102 – 0.365 0.365;表7),即使在随机神经元发作30%的情况下,所有其他路径都显示出重组而不是破坏。 因为S-Inhibition在MLP和注意力元件中分布在7-8层,因此无论目标如何,它都暴露在任何冲刺策略中.
NNM头部在所有12个条件(− 0.205-0.205至− 0.539-0539;表9)中显示阴性补丁d,即其抑制作用脱钩或反转而非仅仅削弱。 我们的假设是,这反映了NNM头像的精确度,需要具体瞄准主题符号,而NM头像的IO复制信号分布得更广;我们不直接测试这一点.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We demonstrate that weight pruning disrupts transformer circuits through two distinct failure modes, driven primarily by component type rather than sparsity level. Magnitude attention head pruning eliminates output-facing heads outright, producing undirected, near-chance failure. Magnitude neuron pruning instead corrupts the MLP context that attention heads depend on, producing confident misdirection that accuracy metrics obscure. At high sparsity, random neuron pruning shows both correct- and incorrect-sign contributions fading toward zero together, a terminal, noise-dominated regime rather than a stable, independently characterisable third mechanism.
blocks.zh: 我们证明,重量的推移通过两种不同的故障模式干扰变压器的电路,这些故障主要是由组件类型驱动,而不是由螺旋级驱动。 巨大的注意力会彻底消除 输出-直立的脑袋 产生不定向的 近距离的失败 放大神经元会腐蚀人们所依赖的 MLP 上下文, 产生自信的错误方向 准确度的度量模糊。 在高伸缩度时,随机的神经元穿刺显示,正确和不正确的信号贡献会逐渐向零一起消失,这是一种以噪声为主的终端系统,而不是一个稳定、独立特征的第三个机制。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: All experiments use GPT-2 small (117M parameters). Larger models have more numerous heads and more distributed, redundant circuits, so the failure modes we report may not transfer directly, and replication at larger scales (e.g. GPT-2 Medium/Large or Pythia) is the most immediate extension.
blocks.zh: 所有实验都使用GPT-2小号(117M参数). 较大的模型拥有更多的头和更多的分布式,冗余的电路,因此我们报告的故障模式可能不会直接传输,在更大的尺度上复制(如GPT-2 Medium/Large或Pythia)是最直接的扩展.

blocks.en: We analyse two circuits, IOI and Greater-Than, on synthetically generated prompts (300 IOI sentences). Synthetic data is standard in circuit analysis but limits ecological validity, and we do not test whether circuit damage affects natural-language tasks that reuse the same computation. The failure-mode taxonomy and the component-type asymmetry should therefore be read as hypotheses to be tested on other circuits (e.g. factual recall, syntactic parsing), not as general principles.
blocks.zh: 我们分析两个电路,即IOI和Greater-Than,关于合成生成的提示(300 IOI句). 合成数据是电路分析中的标准数据,但限制了生态有效性,我们不测试电路损坏是否影响重复使用同一计算的自然语言任务. 因此,应把故障-模式分类学和组件型不对称理解为在其他电路上进行测试的假设(如事实召回,综合剖析),而不是一般原则.

blocks.en: We prune whole attention heads and MLP neurons by zeroing their weights, with no weight updates afterwards, and score importance with simple criteria (the L2 norm of a head’s Q-weight slice, or of a neuron’s W in W_{\text{in}} column). We do not study weight-level unstructured pruning, removal of entire layers or blocks, gradient- or attribution-based criteria, or post-pruning fine-tuning, any of which may change or repair the failure modes we observe.
blocks.zh: 我们通过零重来排出整个注意力头和 MLP 神经元, 之后没有更新重量, 我们不研究重量级无结构的挤压,去除整个层或块,梯度或归属标准,或推后微调,任何一种方法都可能改变或修复我们观察到的故障模式.

blocks.en: GPT-2 small has no safety fine-tuning, so our remarks on refusal- or harm-avoidance mechanisms are an extrapolation from the S-Inhibition and Negative Name Mover circuits, not a measured result.
blocks.zh: GPT-2小号没有安全微调,所以我们对于拒绝-或避免伤害机制的评论是S-Inhibition和负名移动电路的推论,而不是一个测量的结果.

blocks.en: Our SAE analysis (Appendix A.6 ) uses a SAE trained on the base model, so high reconstruction error shows only that activations leave the base model’s feature manifold, not what features the pruned model has. Layer 11 is excluded because the base model’s own reconstruction error exceeds the validity threshold.
blocks.zh: 我们的SAE分析(Appendix A.6 )使用在基模型上训练的SAE, 所以高的重建误差只显示激活会留下基模型的特性复数, 而不是被磨损的模型的特性 。 第11层被排除在外,因为基准模型本身的重建错误超过了有效性阈值.

blocks.en: We track layer-wise next-token accuracy through the logit lens on 500 TinyStories prompts, normalised by the base model’s accuracy at each layer. A model is said to diverge at the first layer where the accuracy drop is significant (Bonferroni-corrected paired t t -test, p < 0.05 p<0.05 ) and exceeds 5 percentage points. Eight of the twelve pruned models diverge at L6 and none diverges earlier. Magnitude attention pruning diverges latest: at L9 for 30% and 50% sparsity (relative accuracy above 0.89) and at L7 for 70% (relative accuracy 0.883). All three magnitude neuron models diverge at L6, with mean relative accuracy 0.670 at 30%, whereas random neuron pruning at 30% reaches 0.881, the same criterion reversal seen in CKA (Table 3 ).

blocks.en: A.6 SAE Reconstruction Errors: Corroborating Evidence for Residual Stream Collapse

blocks.en: Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) reconstruction errors provide an independent, feature-level corroboration of the inversion mechanism described in Section 4.3. A frozen SAE trained on base GPT2 residual stream activations is applied to each compressed variant; relative reconstruction error > 1.0 >1.0 indicates the compressed model’s activations lie outside the SAE’s training distribution, i.e. the residual stream geometry has been fundamentally disrupted.

The key finding is the dissociation between SAE error and circuit head integrity under magnitude neuron pruning. At 30% sparsity, Layer 1 reconstruction error reaches 155.87 155.87 , over 350 × \times the base value, while all 26 IOI circuit heads remain structurally intact (weight norms > 25 >25 ; Section 4.3).
This confirms the context-poisoning mechanism: MLP neuron removal collapses the early residual stream into a low-rank subspace that the frozen SAE cannot reconstruct, thereby corrupting the token-identity encodings that Name Mover heads read from, without physically touching the heads themselves. Random neuron pruning shows a complementary pattern: Layer 6 errors of 16.70 16.70 and 33.11 33.11 at 30%–50% sparsity, consistent with circuit reorganisation at the feature level visible in
the negative path-degradation entries of Table 7 .
